Sword & Shield series · SSH

Sword & Shield

Released February 7, 2020 · 216 cards

Expanded

Sword & Shield is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on February 7, 2020. Its main set has 202 cards, plus 14 secret rares numbered beyond the set (216 in total). It includes 173 Pokémon, 42 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

71 illustrators worked on Sword & Shield. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (19), kirisAki (10), Akira Komayama (8), aky CG Works (8), Kouki Saitou (8), Ryo Ueda (7), Shin Nagasawa (7), Hitoshi Ariga (6).
